maddeler.e:
ننقلب (form VII)
# نَنْقَلِبُ (nanqalibu) /nan.qa.li.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَلَبَ (inqalaba)
# نَنْقَلِبَ (nanqaliba) /nan.qa.li.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَلَبَ (inqalaba)
# نَنْقَلِبْ (nanqalib) /nan.qa.lib/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْقَلَبَ (inqalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
